Title: Biblí svatá, aneb všecka svatá písma Starého i Nového zákona, podlé posledního vydání kralického z roku 1613
Creator: The Bible of Kralice, text of the last Kralice edition (1613); printed for the British and Foreign Bible Society
Publisher: V Praze: Nákladem Britické i Zahraniční Společnosti Biblické, 1887
Publication Date: 1887
Rights: Public Domain (published 1887; pd-us-by-date)
Language: ces
Source: Internet Archive item biblsvataneb00vpra, file biblsvataneb00vpra_djvu.txt, fetched directly by the library/source-research thread (Era VII session), 2026-10-16; host rights statement: the archive.org item record carries no rights field; scan from Robarts, University of Toronto.
Provenance note: Header prepended; the OCR text follows unchanged apart from no characters changed. Rights basis: the imprint year 1887 is 1930 or earlier, so the work is public domain by the project's date rule.
Content note: A nineteenth-century printing of the Kralice Bible text 'according to the last Kralice edition of 1613'. It is not the 1579-93 first edition. Marginal cross-references are printed in the margins and appear in the OCR. OCR sampled at five points (10/30/50/70/90 percent): readable Czech with diacritics, scattered misreads and marginal-reference noise.
